key_findings: EA at GB30/BL40 reduces SNI-induced pain hypersensitivity and lowers spinal dorsal horn Iba-1, BDNF, c-Fos and dendritic spine number.
Intrathecal BDNF lowers mechanical threshold and raises dorsal horn c-Fos, effects reversed by anti-TrkB antibody.
